title: Parent-derived ClinicalPlanningVolume containment failure after candidate-room acceptance
status: IMPLEMENTED / AUTOMATED GREEN / MANUAL RETEST REQUIRED
reproduction_path: 2D18 TECH. OFFICE -> PET/CT Scanner Room -> Use This Room

root_cause.primary: seedPrismParamsFromParent built an axis-aligned box sized to ~50% of the footprint AABB, centered on the vertex mean; for rotated/irregular rooms the box protruded past the actual polygon and the anchor could fall outside it, so the parent-derived volume genuinely failed containment against its own parent.
root_cause.residual: boxContainedInPolygon verified a box shrunk by the wall-clearance inset while the seed built the full-size box, so built corners could protrude beyond what was verified interior.

fix.seed_center: proven-interior anchor (resolveRoomInteriorAnchor) when available, else AABB center, else vertex mean
fix.seed_size: shrink-to-fit: start ~25% XY extent, x0.7 up to 12 steps until corners+edges+center (plus wall-clearance inset) are inside outer polygon and outside holes
fix.box_check_corrected: boxContainedInPolygon now tests halfExtent + inset so the built box is strictly interior with clearance
fix.z_contract: preserved Build 1A floor-aware contract: zLow == room floor, no Z inset (horizontal +X containment ray does not require it; equipment zBase derives from this zLow)
fix.reparent_ux: reparentClinicalFunction selects the new parent space so Build 1A.4 Restore/Reset recovery controls are reachable

limitations: Seed is a conservative axis-aligned box; extreme aspect-ratio rotated rooms get a smaller-than-hand-tuned but guaranteed-contained box (user can grow/rotate via editor with live re-evaluation).
Containment sampling is bounded (corners + edge midpoints + center), robust for planning but not an exact solid-intersection proof.
Approximate-only rooms remain NOT_EVALUATED by design.
manual_retest_steps: Load MRTway Medical Clinic Demo; confirm /viewer renders.
Open candidate-room picker for the PET/CT Scanner Room clinical function.
Select 2D18 TECH. OFFICE and click Use This Room.
Confirm regenerated PET/CT volume shows containment PASS and the new parent is selected.
Confirm equipment placement enabled and Discovery MI identity preserved.
Negative: move volume outside parent -> honest FAIL, Lock disabled with reason, Restore/Reset recover it.
